mkdir project
exec card --store project/.cardamom init --prefix ancestor-
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/init.txt
cmp project/.cardamom/config.yaml $WORK/golden/config.yaml
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: ancestor-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > project/.cardamom/config.yaml'
mkdir project/a/b
cd project/a/b

# The nearest ancestor .cardamom directory supplies the implicit store.
exec card create 'ancestor board'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create.txt

-- golden/init.txt --
initialized project/.cardamom
Automatic local exclusion failed. Add these patterns to .gitignore:
.cardamom/board.sqlite3
.cardamom/board.sqlite3-shm
.cardamom/board.sqlite3-wal
.cardamom/blobs/

# Use card config unset --scope store KEY to restore inheritance.

    prefix: ancestor-
